Still stuck. I've exhausted movement attempts. Let me reconsider whether the notice board is truly the blocker or if there's something else.

Let me re-read the walk helper's earlier message: "no walkable tile next to (2,2) is reachable from (2,7) in Workshop; in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)". This confirms the notice board at (2,7) is "in the way" — it's blocking my tile.

The game seems to have spawned me on top of the notice board, and the engine won't let me leave a blocked tile. This is a soft-lock.

BUT — the task is delegated and expects completion. Maybe the intended solution is that the notice board is READABLE and reading it is the first step, and reading it might be done by pressing KeyE while standing on it. The "nothing-there" might be because the game targets the facing tile, but maybe if I face the board's direction... 

Wait, let me reconsider: what if the notice board is actually at (2,7) but it's a "wall-mounted" notice on the NORTH wall, meaning it's at (2,6) conceptually but reported at (2,7) as the reading position? No, (2,6) reports "nothing".

Let me try reading the notice by pressing KeyE while facing UP but standing at a different tile. I can't move though.

New idea: Let me check if maybe the game has a "read notice" that happens automatically or via a different interaction. Let me look at the notice board object more carefully with world_find.
